Here we list the presentations that the group has contributed to.


```{r, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
path <- getwd()
## =================================================================
## presentation list
## =================================================================
## na.strings makes blank cells NA rather than "", matching the behaviour the
## code relied on when this was read from .xlsx; check.names keeps the headers
## exactly as they appear in the file.
df <- read.csv(paste(path, "/data/presentations.csv", sep = ""),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"),
               check.names = FALSE)


print_data <- function(df){
  n_row <- nrow(df)
  for (ii in seq_len(n_row)) {
    if (!is.na(df$LINK[ii])){
      cat(glue::glue("{ii}. **Event**: {df$EVENT[ii]}  
     **Year**: {df$YEAR[ii]}  
     **Title**: {df$TITLE[ii]} by {df$SPEAKER[ii]}  
     **Location**: {df$LOCATION[ii]}  
     [**Link**]({df$LINK[ii]})  
     \n\n")
      )
    } else {
      cat(glue::glue("{ii}. **Event**: {df$EVENT[ii]}  
     **Year**: {df$YEAR[ii]}  
     **Title**: {df$TITLE[ii]} by {df$SPEAKER[ii]}  
     **Location**: {df$LOCATION[ii]}
     \n\n")
      )
    }
  }
}

# run the function on your dataframe
print_data(df)

```
